changelog:
3.1.5 is a large release: on top of visual polish, it adds dozens of new analysis/AI tools, workflow and export improvements, and several correctness fixes to the physics engine and licensing/update system.

NEW AI/ML DIAGNOSTIC TOOLS
Fresnel PINN (KK-Constrained n/k) — predicts a material's refractive index (n) and extinction coefficient (k) while automatically checking the result for Kramers-Kronig physical consistency.
Deep Ensemble (Fresnel PINN) — trains multiple versions of the n/k model and shows the spread between them as a rough confidence indicator.
Knowledge Distillation (Fresnel PINN) — compresses a trained n/k model into a smaller, faster version.
Spectral Denoising (Transformer) — an alternative noise-cleaning option for spectra, run manually (never auto-applied).
Spectral Anomaly Detection (VAE) — flags whether a new spectrum "looks like" anything measured before, useful as a QC screen.
Spectral Encoder Pretraining — trains a general-purpose spectrum-understanding model from unlabeled spectra files.
Technique Fusion Attention — suggests how much weight to give each measurement technique (UV-Vis/ellipsometry/ATR) when combining them (informational only).
Concept Drift Detector — checks whether a deployed AI model's prediction errors have started behaving differently than expected, an early-warning tool for AI reliability.
Personalized QC Gate — learns from a lab's own past accept/reject history to predict whether a new fit result would likely be accepted.
Fit Plot Visual QC — visually inspects the observed-vs-calculated fit plot image and flags results that "look wrong."
Deposition Endpoint Predictor — forecasts remaining time to a target film thickness during a live deposition/monitoring run.
Virtual Metrology — predicts optical properties from process parameters (or vice versa) using the lab's own historical data, with confidence signals on every prediction.
RL Coating Stack Designer — a reinforcement-learning-based alternative to the existing genetic-algorithm coating designer.
AutoML Model Selector — automatically tries several model types on user-supplied tabular data and reports the best, showing every candidate's score.
Symbolic Kappa Discovery — derives a human-readable formula for kappa (absorption) from measured data that doesn't fit PUMA's built-in models, and can register it for use in calculations.
Train Surrogate Warm-Start Model — trains a fast instant-guess model that seeds a real fit with a good starting point, cutting fit time; selectable directly from Fit Setup.
Agent Command (Natural Language) — type a plain-English instruction and the app plans then executes it, through a safety-gated preview/confirm workflow.
Local LLM Narrative Assistant — an optional, fully local chat assistant for richer plain-language explanations of results.
Similar Past Results — finds the closest-matching materials from a user's own project history to the current result.
Help Search / Physics Reference — local, offline semantic search across PUMA's physics reference documentation.

NEW PHYSICS/OPTICS ANALYSIS TOOLS
Mueller-Matrix (4x4) Ellipsometry — correctly handles "depolarizing" samples (rough surfaces, thick incoherent layers), unlike the older Psi/Delta-only approach.
Graded Film (n(z)/k(z)) — models films whose refractive index changes continuously with depth (e.g., anti-reflection coatings).
PDS/CPM Import + Urbach Fusion — imports PDS/CPM data and combines it with UV-Vis measurements to extend Urbach-energy sensitivity, with a built-in consistency check.
Bayesian MCMC Posterior — full posterior-distribution uncertainty analysis, complementing the existing bootstrap/Hessian tools.
Unified Drude+Interband (TCO) Dispersion Model — a new selectable model for transparent conductive oxide films (ITO/AZO/FTO).
AFM/Profilometer Thickness Prior — lets a fit be gently guided toward an independently measured film thickness.
Joint Multi-Technique Fusion Fit — fits UV-Vis T/R together with ellipsometry and/or ATR data at once, helping resolve thickness/index ambiguity.
Instrument Drift Watchdog — monitors instrument dark/reference readings over time to catch lamp/detector drift early; can now receive real readings directly from the spectrometer import tool.
GUM Uncertainty Budget — a standards-based combination of measurement uncertainty sources into one reported figure.
Literature Eg Reference Check — compares a fit-extracted band-gap value against sourced literature values for known materials, flagging mismatches honestly.
Sensitivity Localization — shows where in the spectrum a chosen fit parameter has the most influence.
Alternate Optimizers — Bayesian Optimization and GP-surrogate multi-fidelity search, as exploratory alternatives to the standard fit method.
Fit Math Utilities — standalone calculators for weighted chi-square and warm-start-centered bound narrowing.
Spectrometer File-Only Import — imports dark/reference/sample spectra exported from an instrument's own vendor software and produces a properly corrected spectrum.
Custom Stack Workbench (free-form layer editor) — build an arbitrary multilayer stack with full control per layer, beyond the three fixed templates.
Global Stack Fit (Multi-Angle) — fits film thickness against measured reflectance across one or more incidence angles simultaneously.
TMM Stack Simulator: ATR penetration-depth readout — shows how deep the probe light reaches into the sample in ATR mode.
Model Setup AR-coating thickness optimizer — automatically minimizes reflectance around a target wavelength.
Parameter Sweep: Monte Carlo mode + new sampling methods — reports mean and standard deviation from randomized n/k perturbation trials; 1D sweeps can use Latin Hypercube or Sobol sampling.

PROJECT, WORKFLOW & EXPORT IMPROVEMENTS
Compare Project Files (Project Diff) — diffs two saved project files' datasets, configurations, and runs against each other.
Undo/Redo now works (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y) for fit/model setup changes.
OS-level notifications when a fit run finishes, even if the window is minimized.
Audit Trail viewer — a new window showing the project's activity log.
Local Project Version History — automatic snapshots before each save overwrite (up to 20 versions), with a viewer to browse/reopen past versions.
Recipe/SOP Locking — data-processing recipes can be locked/unlocked, recorded in the audit log.
Report Language, Executive Summary, and Plausibility Highlighting on export — English/Arabic report language, a plain-language executive summary, and automatic highlighting of questionable results in exported PDF/Excel reports.
Report Integrity Checksum — every exported PDF/Excel report carries a tamper-evident checksum.
Compare Results: per-curve opacity sliders to more easily compare overlapping samples.
Compare Results: Compute Trends — fits thickness/band-gap/average-n/Urbach-energy against a process value (e.g., deposition temperature) across multiple runs.
Compare Results: overlay measured T/R curves across selected runs, not just fitted n/k.
Fit History Timeline — a chronological view of every past run for a project.
Live Sandbox Preview — instant thickness/n/k slider that redraws the T/R curve in real time without running a full fit.
Despike on Import — an off-by-default checkbox that automatically removes narrow outlier spikes from raw imported spectra.
Voice Control — offline, fixed-vocabulary voice commands via microphone.
One-Click Diagnostic Bundle — zips the current project, logs, and environment info for support.
Guided Troubleshooting Wizard — walks through a fit's automated quality checks and suggests next steps for anything flagged.
High Contrast theme — a new WCAG-accessible color theme in Preferences.
Import Extension Spectrum -> Data Factory bridge — send imported channels directly into a Data Factory recipe with one button.
Export Center: SCOUT results export — extension results can now be exported directly as CSV/JSON/XLSX/PDF from the GUI (previously command-line only).
Multi-Data batch fitting: optional smoothing for each queued file before fitting.
TMM Stack Simulator auto-recompute as fields change, instead of requiring a manual Compute click.
Faster app startup — roughly 11-21 seconds shaved off launch time.

GUI AND USABILITY FIXES
Fixed cramped, overlapping toolbar icons under the top command bar (e.g. after clicking "Results").
Fixed cut-off text in Physics tab summary tiles — the tile grid now automatically resizes to fit the window.
Fixed cramped dropdown menu items (e.g. Results view's "Local view" selector).
Fixed popup dialogs that could run off the bottom of the screen with no way to reach the action buttons — dialogs now scroll.
Fixed a duplicate button in the Mueller-Matrix Ellipsometry tool.
Sped up hover/crosshair tooltips on plots by roughly 75-85x, and fixed a bug where one bad data point could permanently freeze the tooltip.
Added tooltips across previously unlabeled Compute/Fit/Solve buttons.
Added confirmation prompts before destructive actions ("Archive & Remove," "Clear Queue").
Fixed the Export button's tooltip disappearing whenever it was actually usable.
Added a "busy" cursor during longer calculations so the app no longer looks frozen.
Fixed Preferences theme selector — a saved High Contrast theme previously displayed incorrectly as "Light" and silently reverted.
Fixed Kramers-Kronig consistency display — the KK tile no longer shows a bare percentage that could read as a failing grade on physically consistent data.

PHYSICS/CORRECTNESS FIXES
Fixed the speed-of-light constant, previously an approximation (3.0e8) instead of the exact SI value, was introducing small (~0.07-0.14%) errors into conductivity/dispersion calculations.
Fixed a crash/silent-corruption risk in the core fitting engine for very thick or highly absorbing multi-film stacks.
Fixed the automatic spike-removal (despiking) filter, which originally missed real spikes on smooth data and over-flagged noisy data.
Fixed the Instrument Drift Watchdog's drift-detection math, which could misclassify a genuinely drifting instrument as healthy.
Fixed the Literature Eg Check to use per-material tolerances and refuse comparisons when measurement definitions don't match.
Fixed an absorption/model-mismatch warning that previously never reached the user, or fired incorrectly.
Added official reference spectral data (real CIE D65 and ASTM G173/AM1.5G tables, properly licensed and tamper-checked), existing default report calculations are unchanged.

LICENSING, UPDATES & SECURITY
Fixed a critical gap where license-activation and update-check were never actually invoked in any shipped build, both are now genuinely active.
Hardened license files against copying between machines by binding them to a per-installation device ID.
Enabled cryptographically signed update manifests so update notifications can be verified as genuinely from PUMA.
